backward_compat_traps.rule: MDIO has NO START/STOP conditions and NO per-byte ACK; PHY selection is by a 5-bit PHYAD field inside a fixed 32-bit frame.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Decoding MDIO as I2C (SDA/SCL start/stop + 7-bit slave address + ACK) is wrong — MDIO is a fixed-frame management bus.

backward_compat_traps.rule: The 2-bit ST field selects the clause: 01 = Clause 22 direct addressing, 00 = Clause 45 indirect addressing.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating a Clause 45 ST=00 frame as a Clause 22 frame misreads OP and the indirect-address model.

fields.spec_version: IEEE 802.3 Clause 22 (basic MII management) and Clause 45 (extended MMD management)

key_changes.summary: Spec counter increased; config-bit change during master transmission now aborts the transmission and forces idle state.
CPHA=0 slave-mode transfer description changed; CPHA=1 master-mode transfer description changed; bidirectional master-mode mode-fault note added.
Enhanced receive-buffer functionality (SPIF / SPIDR handling on missed-read case); SPI-slave in wait/stop mode behavior clarified; max-allowed-baud-rate note added.
Minor rewording of Section 3.1.5 (SPI Data Register).

fields.version_naming_history_note: Early dot-versions (0.1-0.8) became formal V02.02 in July 2001 (renamed for SRS2.0 template); subsequent versions follow V0Maj.Min scheme.
post_primer_evolution_industry_note: IEEE Std 1149.1-2001 — major revision; mandatory IDCODE (when Device ID register is present), tightened BSDL, post-1990 cleanup.
IEEE Std 1149.1-2013 — further revision; programmable test access (PDL), BSDL packaging, ICL/PDL Tcl-bindings via IEEE 1687 IJTAG.
IEEE Std 1149.4 — Mixed-Signal Test Bus (analog boundary scan, layered on 1149.1).
IEEE Std 1149.6 — Advanced I/O test (AC-coupled and differential pin testing).
IEEE Std 1149.7 — Compact JTAG (cJTAG); 2-pin reduction of 1149.1.
IEEE Std 1687-2014 — Internal JTAG (IJTAG); standardized hierarchical instrument access on top of 1149.1.
ARM JTAG-DP / SWD — ARM CoreSight debug access port; layered on 1149.1 (or 2-pin Serial Wire Debug).

future_versions_industry_outline.summary: 10 Gb/s over 4-pair Cat 6a / Cat 7 UTP using LDPC + DSQ128 modulation; introduces Clause 55 PHY.
Adds Low-Power Idle (LPI) signaling for 100BASE-TX, 1000BASE-T, 10GBASE-T — Clause 78.
Introduces 40 Gb/s and 100 Gb/s over multi-lane fiber (40GBASE-SR4, 100GBASE-LR4, etc.) and Clause 81 XLGMII / CGMII.
100 Gb/s over backplane + twinax with FEC.
Single-pair automotive Ethernet PHYs sharing the same Clause 4 MAC.
Higher per-lane PAM4 rates targeting 800 GbE / 1.6 TbE.

lineage.summary: Original MII Management (MIIM) interface: 32-bit frame, 5-bit PHYAD, 5-bit REGAD, 32 registers.
Extends MDIO for 10G+ PHYs: ST=00, indirect addressing, 5-bit PRTAD + 5-bit DEVAD (MMD), 65536 registers.
